reason: Owner request 2026-11-19: add a product search to the PIC Daily Sheet, then move it inside the sheet by the proximity principle.
text: A control belongs next to what it changes, and that decides WHERE a search box goes. On the commissary Daily Sheet the Destinations chips choose which COLUMNS render; a product search narrows which ROWS. Parking the search in that chip row made the operator look in the wrong place (owner: 'move the PIC search bar inside the daily sheets. proximity principle'), so it lives directly above the product table, left-aligned over the PRODUCT column. Three things a row filter must not break: (1) PRINT - a filtered production document must never print as if complete, so the filter is released in @media print with rows forced back to table-row; (2) the in-place refresh after a saved beginning replaces every row, so remember the query and re-apply it or the operator retypes after every save; (3) never let a filtered table read as the whole one - show 'N of M' and an explicit no-match row, because an empty table says 'no products exist' when it means 'your search matched nothing'. Search client-side: a server round-trip discards unsaved cell edits.
